title: Volume 1 Chapter 10: Buddy
content: Chapter 10: Buddy
The girls of Class 5, ordered to deploy, were changing into their Valkyrie suits in the locker room.

Sixteen-year-old Megumi Suzuki, with short hair and a strong-willed face, was a sporty girl with tanned skin. She excelled physically and had achieved excellent grades in the Middle School Division. Because of that, she was a student who firmly believed she would be scouted without a doubt.
In her sporty underwear, she made a declaration that was almost a challenge to the other girls around her.
“If I perform well in actual combat, I’ll get scouted and transferred, right? That’s a breeze. I’m getting out of Class 5 as soon as I can.”

Listening to Megumi’s words was Asami Asai, who had dark blue hair cut into a short bob. Pale-skinned, slender, and tall, she was eighteen and in her third year in Class 5. If she didn’t produce results and get transferred within the year, she would graduate as just a Valkyrie candidate. For a girl at the academy, that was a frustrating outcome.
Asami, who had been training hard in Class 5 to avoid regrets, was irritated by Megumi’s remarks.
“If you were really outstanding, you’d have been scouted by the time you graduated from Middle School.”
“Even if a senior stuck in Class 5 says that, it doesn’t bother me.”
“It’s fine to be confident, but many who said that ended up graduating from Class 5 anyway. You should be careful too.”
“...Don’t underestimate me! I’m not like you guys!”

Megumi slammed her fist on the locker with a bang! Nearby, Kanako Nishitani, a girl with a distinctive long hair style who was changing clothes, flinched and shook her shoulders. Timid Kanako was small and cute, but surprisingly she wore provocative black lingerie.
“Ugh, everyone’s so fired up, it’s scary.”

Kanako’s timid words drew sharp looks from the others. The meaning behind those harsh gazes was something like, “Why is a coward even here?” Even the instructor thought it unnecessary to have chosen Kanako.
The tense atmosphere before deployment spread throughout the locker room.

Ignoring the other girls, Louise stripped off her uniform to reveal pink lingerie. Though only her head was exposed since the rest was covered, the tight fabric clung to her skin, clearly showing her body’s contours. Each suit had subtle modifications by individual, but the form-fitting nature was consistent.
Louise wore a standard pilot suit. After a breath, she smiled.
“Come on, hurry up or you’ll lose points. Everyone, quick, quick!”
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wYK6cK0.jpeg

Louise’s bright voice echoed through the locker room, and Kanako relaxed, while Megumi and Asami stopped arguing and hurried to change. When Louise left the locker room first, her expression immediately tightened. Though she gave off the air of being ready for combat at any moment, the words she spoke were the exact opposite.
Checking no one was listening, she whispered with a hint of sadness.
“...I hope I don’t have to go this time.”

The Valkyries were transported to the site by a large transport aircraft equipped with jet engines on its rotary wing axis. It was a tandem wing aircraft with main wings fore and aft, powered by four jet engines.
Multiple hatches were installed on the sides of the transport, inside which the Valkyries’ Battle Dresses were stored. Folded and secured, the girls stood before their own Battle Dresses.
Walking among the girls facing their Battle Dresses was their homeroom teacher, now dressed in combat gear. As she walked, she scanned their faces.

“This operation is to support the Boots Cat Battalion. Your mission is to mop up any Gijuu they miss. Basically, you’ll be on standby at the beach, but a request came to send six members as reinforcements to the front lines. We’ll form two squads of three machines each.”
The girls’ eyes changed. Some saw this as a chance and welcomed it, while others grew nervous at the thought of actual combat.
The teacher stopped and said,

“To those candidates lucky enough to be deployed: as I’ve told you many times in class, the Battle Dresses you operate are just training machines. They differ fundamentally in performance from the Valkyrie Dresses used by official Valkyries. If you encounter a First Class Gijuu, you have no chance. Retreat immediately.”

The Battle Dresses used by Class 5 were inferior in performance compared to the real Valkyrie Dresses used by true Valkyries. They were training machines with only the bare minimum capabilities. Still, they were more than enough to handle Second Class or lower.

Class 5’s role this time was to eliminate the Second Class Gijuu that the Boots Cat Battalion had missed. Ground forces would also be deployed, so missing any Second Class would cause severe damage to allies.
The teacher confirmed the girls had tightened their resolve and explained the details.
“The Gate that appeared this time is medium-sized, but fortunately, the number of First Class is small. Leave the enemy main force to Boots Cat and focus on your own task.”
“Yes, ma’am!”
Unlike in the classroom, everyone here responded in unison with determination.
The teacher announced the squad formations.
“The First Squad will be led by Asami. Suzuki and Nishitani will be members.”

When eighteen-year-old Asami, who had no margin left, was appointed squad leader, Megumi openly showed her displeasure. Kanako, on the other hand, looked relieved that the experienced Asami was squad leader.
“The Second Squad is—”
When the Second Squad members were announced, Louise’s name was not among them.

Regarding the order of Gijuu appearances: the Gate that first connected to the other world appears first. Gijuu pour out from the Gate, and the battle won’t end until Valkyries destroy it. Occasionally, the Gate closes after releasing a certain number, but that’s an exception.

Inside the development team’s transport, I quietly waited in Thunderbolt’s cockpit. This time, the purpose was to be on the battlefield, not to engage in combat. The weapons were prepared under the pretext of giving the development team’s workers emergency training. Knowing Dr. Smith, he might have hoped for live-fire training if possible.
Peeking into the open cockpit hatch was Dr. Allison.
“Your heart rate has risen a bit but is stable. Magic power output is stable too... as expected of a battle-hardened soldier. You seem a little nervous, though.”
She seemed concerned about my elevated heart rate.
“A moderate amount of tension is an ally.”
Dr. Allison shrugged.
“If there’s no problem, that’s fine. But it’s a shame not to deploy after all this preparation. Maybe I should at least let you do some shooting practice?”
Even Dr. Allison seemed to think I wouldn’t be deployed this time.
When she left the machine and returned to her post, I was alone again. I waited, mentally prepared to deploy at any moment, when the comm line opened.
“Ren-kun, are you okay over there?”
“Louise? We’re in the middle of the operation.”
“Since you’re technically deploying as part of Class 5, the comm line is open so you can connect with your comrades. Though it seems everyone else is deliberately not opening their lines.”
“Oh, right. That was my mistake.”

Though I was part of the Prometheus Project, I had forgotten that I was also enrolled in Class 5 at the academy. I should have discussed with Dr. Allison what to do in this case. The academy’s response would also be involved, so a meeting would be necessary.
“How’s it going over there?”
Some of the operation status was displayed on the monitor, but there was information that only those on site could know. I wanted to hear the words of the soldiers there.
Louise chuckled wryly.
“Everyone’s eager to deploy, fighting over Second Class Gijuu. They’re desperate to build up achievements and make an impression.”
Louise’s tone was exasperated, but I worried about her.
“Don’t you think you should deploy too, Louise?”
Considering the future, we should be racking up kill counts, but she didn’t seem keen.
“Getting obsessed with kill counts means you’re underestimating the battlefield. I can’t be like that.”
I nodded slightly in agreement with Louise’s wry smile.
“...That’s true. The battlefield always brings unexpected situations.”
I sensed danger in the girls going out just to make an impression. I hoped it would end without incident, but it seemed impossible.
“...The First Squad? Is that true?”
“What’s wrong, Louise?”
Louise started talking to someone else, looking quite flustered.
“Reinforcements of Gijuu appeared, and the First Squad that chased them too far got caught.”
Shortly before the First Squad encountered enemy reinforcements, they were flying around hunting Gijuu.
“Kya ha ha ha! Take this, fly away!”

Kanako was blasting off the head of a Second Class Gijuu with a large rifle mounted on her sub-arm. Perhaps adrenaline had flooded her system, or her timid personality had reversed, because she had become aggressively combative.
Megumi clicked her tongue at Kanako’s success.
“She’s already taken down three! At this rate, I’m going to lose my position! Damn it, she was so quiet during training!”
Megumi stabbed a lance-type melee weapon held by the large sub-arm into a Gijuu, then channeled magic power into it, causing a discharge.
“My electric shock should work, right?”
Pulling the lance from the charred Gijuu, it fell into the sea.
As the two pushed forward, their squad leader Asami shouted.
“Don’t get too far ahead, both of you! You’re out of the designated area. This is the front line now!”
Asami held a gatling gun on her large sub-arm and gripped a spear herself. Her combat style was to shoot Gijuu with the gatling gun and stab with the spear if they broke through.
However, she was mostly covering the other two, and the squad still had zero Second Class kills.
Kanako turned back, flying backward, and yelled at Asami.
“If you hide in the back, the Boots Cat cats will hunt all the Second Class! I want to fight more, much more!”
Kanako’s personality shift was so extreme even Megumi was taken aback.
“So that’s why the teacher picked her. Too aggressive.”
Even Megumi said Kanako was too aggressive. Kanako quickly found her next target and attacked.
“Fourth one down!”
Kanako stabbed a greatsword mounted on her left arm’s large sub-arm into the Gijuu, forcibly cutting off its head. Asami looked up and shouted to the two.
“R-Retreat! Everyone, retreat!!”
Looking up to see what was happening, the two saw several black dots in the sky. One of them dove at Megumi.
Hit by the enemy’s body slam, Megumi screamed as she fell.
“Why now, of all times!!”
Though knocked down, she rose just above the sea surface and regained her posture. Looking around, they were already surrounded by dozens of Second Class Gijuu.
Asami immediately covered, but seeing the number of enemies, her face turned pale.
“...We went too deep. Surrounded by this many.”
Dozens of Second Class surrounded them, aiming carefully. The three were trapped, unable to escape.
“The First Squad encountered enemy reinforcements? What!?”
“It seems the First Squad was surrounded by Second Class. They were close to where reinforcements appeared, so the warning didn’t reach them in time.”
The area around the Gate was hard to detect even with radar, and impossible without visual confirmation. The problem was that the First Squad had ventured into such a dangerous area.
If they were regular Valkyries, they might have handled it, but they were candidates using training machines. Surrounded and isolated, they would be torn apart by Gijuu.
At that thought, vivid memories of that humanoid Gijuu killing comrades flooded my mind, and I was seized by impatience. My voice grew louder, forgetting my position.
“Let’s go rescue them immediately!”
Louise looked surprised.
“Whoa, I didn’t expect Ren-kun to show so much emotion.”
“!? S-Sorry.”

I shook my head, trying to calm myself. I was a test pilot in the Prometheus Project; acting on personal feelings was not allowed. Besides, the experimental machine wasn’t ready for combat deployment.
“I lost my composure. Please forget what I just said.”
When I retracted my statement, Louise seemed to be thinking deeply. She nodded slightly, then confirmed my intention.
“Ren-kun, do you want to deploy?”
“...No, that would be a decision beyond my authority.”
I bowed my head, suppressing my desire to help. I had no right to decide to deploy on my own.
“I’m asking because I want to know your feelings! Don’t you want to help?”
Louise’s firm tone made me look up sharply.
“Y-Yes, I want to help.”
Louise nodded vigorously and opened a comm line to the Class 5 instructor. When the instructor’s face appeared on the monitor, he looked suspicious, probably seeing my image too.
“What is it? We’re busy here. If it’s not urgent—”
“I volunteer to assist in the rescue of the First Squad.”
Louise spoke quietly but firmly, and the instructor’s expression stiffened for a moment. What could a mere candidate on a training machine do? He seemed to think it wasn’t worth wasting time.
Though they were Second Class, their numbers made them a threat to Valkyrie candidates. The assumption was that Louise understood this.
“Are you not acting out of despair or heroism?”
The instructor asked for confirmation, and Louise answered clearly.
“We’ll buy time until the Boots Cat rescue team arrives. If a little more force joins, we can hold out until then.”
The instructor showed a troubled look for a moment, then accepted Louise’s proposal.
“—Understood. Gather the scattered forces.”
He intended to assemble the Valkyrie candidates scattered to defeat Second Class and then send them for rescue. Louise judged that wouldn’t be fast enough.
She looked at me through the monitor and suggested to the instructor.
“That won’t be quick enough. Ren-kun... request deployment of the experimental machine.”
The instructor thought for a few seconds, then said with annoyance,
“You heard that, Hifumi? I’ll talk to the person in charge. You support Louise.”
“!? Understood!”
“Honestly, I don’t know if sending out an unproven experimental machine will help... Louise, I hope your judgment doesn’t cost lives.”
The instructor doubted Thunderbolt’s capabilities. Expecting results from an untested humanoid weapon was unreasonable.
Louise smiled.
“Please expect great things from me and Ren-kun as buddies!”
She saluted cutely, but the instructor’s face disappeared from the monitor immediately.
I thanked Louise.
“I appreciate your trust. I’ll do my best not to be a burden.”

“Haha, it’s fine. You seemed so eager to deploy. But from here on, it’s the Valkyries’ battlefield. I’ll support you, but with First Class present, I might not be able to cover you. Are you sure you want to deploy?”
Louise asked, and I gripped the control stick tightly. Though I regretted deciding to deploy without consulting Dr. Allison, my desire to help my comrades was stronger.
“I guess I’ve been pretty influenced by the academy.”
“That means...”
“I’m a failure as a soldier, but if I don’t deploy now, I won’t forgive myself. Louise, I’ll accompany you.”
“Ahaha! Ren-kun, you’re really becoming like an academy student!”
Louise smiled cheerfully, accepting my resolve.
